entries.title: Geometric Brownian motion
entries.description: The change in the stock price over a short time is a drift term proportional to the price plus a random term proportional to the price.

entries.title: Itô's lemma for the option value
entries.description: The change in the option value over a short time is a drift term plus a random term that depends on how sensitive the option is to the stock price.

entries.title: Black–Scholes partial differential equation
entries.description: Relates the option value’s changes with time and stock price under the chapter’s risk-neutral pricing argument.

entries.title: Black–Scholes call price
entries.description: The price of a European call is the stock price times N of d one, minus the strike discounted to today times N of d two.

entries.title: Black–Scholes put price
entries.description: The price of a European put is the strike discounted to today times N of minus d two, minus the stock price times N of minus d one.

entries.title: The terms d one and d two
entries.description: Defines the standardized quantities used in the Black–Scholes call and put pricing formulas.

entries.title: The call price in Python
entries.description: A Python function that returns the Black–Scholes price of a European call from the spot price, the strike, the interest rate, the volatility and the years to expiry.
